summary: I tested both the backend and the frontend for: Timesheets (hours only) with Excel export, participant invoices, participant addresses with the clock-in location check, and the regression after splitting participant_mgmt.py. New backend suite test_iter62: 18 passed and 1 skipped (-n 0). The skipped test is the clock-out step, which the Jotform case-note gate blocks for the test worker. I covered that step with a separate in-process check that stubs the case-note gate: a flagged clock-in followed by an in-window clock-out gives awaiting_approval, and an unflagged one gives completed. Regression (-n 0): iter60 11/11, iter61 9/9, iter59 9/10, iter58 18/21. All 4 failures are old test expectations that the iter59 case-note gate and the 'declined worker can't be re-rostered' rule made out of date. None are caused by the refactor. An AST comparison of every function and class in the HEAD version of participant_mgmt.py against the new pm_common, pm_funding and participant_mgmt shows identical code for everything except create_shift, cancel_shift, ClockIn, clock_in, clock_out and roster_report. Those six were changed on purpose: iter60/61 swaps and re-rostering, and this session's location work. So the funding endpoints have no behaviour change. Frontend at 390x844, all flows passed: the /pm options show the right items for each role; Timesheets (custom range, weekly breakdown, 'My hours' for workers, Excel export for office users only); Invoices (check, preview, create NL-000001, mark paid and unpaid, filters, void with confirm, create again after void as NL-000002, details sheet with defaults No Limitts Pty Ltd / 92 606 960 730 / 14 days, save, PDF opens); Addresses (edit and save, real geocoding worked in the pod and showed 'On map'); clock-in pre-permission sheet (Clock in without location gives a flagged toast); location already granted (no sheet, sent at 0 m, not flagged); ApproveSheet shows approve-location for flagged clock-ins and approving works. No deprecated packages found. Seeded data, invoices, invoice_seq and invoice_settings were all removed, so the database is back to how it started.

minor.issue: Shifts still awaiting approval in the period are silently left out, and the preview doesn't mention them. If Rosters approve them later, they are only picked up if Finance runs a range that covers those dates again. Suggest returning a pending count in /invoices/uninvoiced and showing it in the inv-preview sheet.

clock_in.location stores the worker's raw lat/lng, and shift_view returns it to every user who can view the shift. Consider removing lat/lng for users who aren't Rosters or Finance (keep flagged and note).
There's no maximum date range, unlike timesheets (93 days) and the roster report (90 days). That's fine for now, but you might add a cap.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /pm/invoices directly as a support worker shows a spinner for several seconds because react-query retries the 403 before ErrorState appears. Low impact, because the option is hidden for these users. Suggest retry:false for 403 errors.

issues: The Cancel buttons in the inv-preview and inv-settings sheets have no testID
The preview accepts a future 'To' date and shows counts. Generate then fails with a toast. You could check the date during Check instead.

react_native_issues.issue: Metro warns that `expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` is deprecated. Use `expo-router/native-tabs`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:3

action_items: Update the stale regression tests: in iter58, test_clock_*_completes, the 422 test and test_report_xlsx now get 409 case_note_required from the iter59 gate. In iter59, test_decline_rules_and_notify re-rosters to the same worker, which is now rejected. Either stub has_case_note or change what the tests expect.
Optional: show a count of shifts awaiting approval in the invoice preview (uninvoiced endpoint)
Optional: remove the raw lat/lng from clock_in.location in shift_view for users who aren't Rosters or Finance
Optional: migrate from expo-router/unstable-native-tabs to expo-router/native-tabs (app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:3)
Optional: retry:false on 403 in invoices/addresses queries; add testIDs to the sheet Cancel buttons
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor check: an AST comparison against HEAD shows no changes to any funding or helper function after moving them to pm_common and pm_funding
The invoice generate flow claims shifts before inserting the invoice, so the same shift can't be billed twice even if two users generate at the same time. Good.

pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, which runs module-scoped seed fixtures once per worker. Run the iter58-62 suites with -n 0, otherwise there are cross-worker errors (the first run of iter58-61 under xdist showed 13 failed and 11 errors).

success_rate.backend: 100% of new feature tests (18/18, 1 skipped because of the Jotform gate but covered by the in-process check). Regression 47/51; the 4 failures are stale expectations, not refactor regressions.

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ participants, fundings, shifts, invoices and a TEST worker. All removed by id. The meta keys invoice_seq and invoice_settings were deleted because neither existed before testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the suites with `-n 0`. ui_seed_iter62.py seed|clean creates par_ui62/fund_ui62 with completed shifts about 5 weeks ago (a Monday), an in-window accepted shift and a flagged awaiting_approval shift. With JOTFORM configured, clock-out returns 409 case_note_required for the test worker. To test clock-out, stub routes.roster_extras.has_case_note in-process. Geocoding (photon) works from the pod.
